about: How each pinned raster was made. The generators are copied here for the record; they read private inputs that stay outside Git: the Meshy continent GLB (sha256 42c887398a86d6f3675cf1e5396234d972b3544fb795e877d6cfa4771f155d30) and the A3 draft mask (work-output drafts.py compose(A3)), and the staged base from build_continent_v2_ground.py --base.

strait-fills-north-coast.note: the approved A3 draft new-land mask (drafts.py compose(A3)) resampled to 2 m; harmonic join to the old coast (at most 6 m), plain bands by area, 40 m shelf, colours inpainted from inland land, old beach band repainted

strait-fills-b22-bars.note: the approved A3 draft new-land mask (drafts.py compose(A3)) resampled to 2 m; harmonic join to the old coast (at most 6 m), plain bands by area, 40 m shelf, colours inpainted from inland land, old beach band repainted

north-isle.note: Meshy continent GLB (sha256 42c88739...) surface at offset (3560,-1650): z-buffered at 2 m, the vertical curve applied, objects opened away, heights x0.5 (walkable share like the main isle's hill maps), the approved A3 draft coast (fine warp), coastal taper, citadel terrace pad, pits filled

south-east-isle.note: Meshy continent GLB (sha256 42c88739...) surface at offset (3000,-1620), heights x0.5, lagoon lowland within 260 m of Tollholm and Spindle Hill, the approved A3 draft coast (fine warp) kept 8 m clear of the berths and sea lanes, temple summit pad, pits filled
